scope: Acquisition only. Three independent fresh nominal trajectories on the same 0.1 mm guided surface seam, each with one fixed guarded final-bite request cap. Not benchmark acceptance, not a noise live run, and never an optical withdrawal authorization.
acquisition: Use the native guided visual approach, guarded reviews and closed entry-clearance recipe. Require both sealed 7 mm review exposures to match array-for-array before arming the registered diagnostic bite. The fixed cap can only reduce the requested advance. Keep the 9 mm working target, absolute 10 mm limit, 0.15 mm reserve, fresh visual sweep/alignment, and existing movement budgets. One attempted final advance and at most one additional actual closure. After it, perform the normal 3 mm micro-backoff, fresh visual entry estimate, same guarded closed entry-clearance, and identical review optics. Hold closed after acquisition or fail closed. No structural length or offline reader output selects a target, permits a bite or branches the capture path; original mechanical vetoes still apply. No repeat when coverage is missing.
offline_gate: Replay the final cleared exposure of every case with v2 (raw and archived deterministic 0.5 mm depth noise) before opening the structure labels. Require all joints/guards/closed acquisition valid, unchanged structure between the two final exposures, and actual prefixes covering 8,9,10 on distinct trajectories with exact BELOW(8), TARGET(9), TARGET(10) in both variants. Misses and out-of-set structural outcomes do not count. No authority or Level 0 implied by a pass.
